spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (सुह्यति)
1 To bear, to endure.
2 To be content or satisfied.
3 To be able.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having a cheerful smiling face.
E.
सु, हस laughing, आनन face.

m. (-स्तिः)
One of the ten persons called Pūrbadharas by the Jainas.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Satiate, satisfied.
2 Fit, right, suitable.
3 Kindly, friendly.
f. (-ता)
One of the tongues of AGNI or fire.
E.
सु well, हित placed, &c.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Friendly, cordial, kind.
E.
सुहृत् a friend, तमप् aff.

f. (-त्ता)
Friendship, affection.
E.
सुहृत्, and तल् aff.; also सुहृत्वं.

m. (-हृद् or हृत्)
1 A friend.
2 An ally.
E.
सु good, kind, हृद् heart.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Good hearted.
E.
सु excellent, हृदय the heart.

n. (-लं)
The army of an ally.
E.
सुहृद्, and वल an army.

m. (-दः)
The separation of friends.
E.
सुहृद्, and भेद division.
